en.headline: Advance Decision on Life-sustaining Treatment Ordinance takes effect
en.dek: The new law provides a legal framework for advance medical directives and do-not-attempt CPR orders, offering protection for patients’ wishes and for medical staff who follow them.
body: The Advance Decision on Life-sustaining Treatment Ordinance came into effect on Friday, establishing a statutory framework for advance medical directives and do-not-attempt cardiopulmonary resuscitation orders in Hong Kong.

The ordinance allows terminally ill patients to record their preferences on life-sustaining treatment in advance. It also provides legal protection for medical professionals and rescuers who comply with valid advance medical directives or DNACPR orders.

The Secretary for Health appointed 31 July 2026 as the commencement date through a notice published in the Gazette in May. The government has said training will be provided to ensure medical staff understand the new arrangements.
The law is intended to respect the autonomous choices of patients concerning end-of-life care while giving clearer safeguards to those who act in accordance with the documented wishes.

zh.headline: 《維持生命治療的預作決定條例》今日生效
zh.dek: 新法例為預設醫療指示及不作心肺復甦術命令提供法律框架，保障病人意願及遵從指示的醫護人員。
body: 《維持生命治療的預作決定條例》星期五起生效，為本港預設醫療指示及不作心肺復甦術命令訂立法定框架。
條例容許末期病患者預先記錄對維持生命治療的意願，同時為遵從有效預設醫療指示或不作心肺復甦術命令的醫護人員及救援人員提供法律保障。
醫務衛生局局長早前藉憲報公告，指定2026年7月31日為條例主要條文的生效日期。當局表示會提供培訓，確保醫護人員了解新安排。
法例旨在尊重病人對臨終護理的自主選擇，並為按文件所載意願行事的人士提供更清晰的保障。
